US.notes: Works published before (current_year-95) are PD (before 1931 in 2026). Unpublished works: life+70 (PD-US-unpublished needs never published before 2003). Per Commons, works by authors who died before 1977 that were first published 1978-2002 are protected until 2048. Foreign works published 1931+ may be URAA-restored (no rule of shorter term). Creation year is only a proxy for publication: paintings are often first published (reproduced) later.
